name: Leadforce (Neon CRM) — Full Pipeline: Enrich (Apollo) → Validate (Clay) → Qualify & Personalize → Send (SpaceMail) — every 15 min

parameters.query:
SELECT id, first_name, last_name, full_name, email, job_title, school_district, district_name, state
FROM leads
WHERE enriched_at IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 50

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name, email: $json.email, organization_name: $json.school_district || $json.district_name, reveal_personal_emails: false }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE leads SET
  job_title = COALESCE($2, job_title),
  linkedin_url = COALESCE($3, linkedin_url),
  seniority = COALESCE($4, seniority),
  enriched_at = now()
WHERE id = $1

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Loop Enrich — 1 at a time').item.json.id }}, ={{ ($json.person || {}).title || null }}, ={{ ($json.person || {}).linkedin_url || null }}, ={{ ($json.person || {}).seniority || null }}

parameters.query:
SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, school_district, district_name
FROM leads
WHERE enriched_at IS NOT NULL AND email_valid IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 50

UPDATE leads SET
  email_valid = $2,
  email_status = $3,
  email_risk = $4
WHERE id = $1

parameters.query:
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT allowed_job_titles, excluded_job_titles, active_states
  FROM client_profiles WHERE client_id = 'ryan-cahill'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT l.id
  FROM leads l
  CROSS JOIN cfg
  WHERE l.email_valid = 'valid'
    AND l.email_subject IS NULL
    AND l.state = ANY(cfg.active_states)
    AND l.job_title IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM unnest(cfg.allowed_job_titles) AS allowed
      WHERE l.job_title ILIKE '%' || allowed || '%'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM unnest(cfg.excluded_job_titles) AS excl
      WHERE l.job_title ILIKE '%' || excl || '%'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list sup WHERE lower(sup.email) = lower(l.email)
    )
)
UPDATE leads l SET
  email_subject = 'Complimentary Pension Review – ' || COALESCE(l.first_name, 'there') || ', are you maximizing your CalSTRS/CalPERS benefits?',
  email_body = 'Hi ' || COALESCE(l.first_name, 'there') || ',' || E'\n\n' ||
    'My name is Ryan Cahill and I help educate CalSTRS and CalPERS employees with regards to the California State Teachers Retirement System Pension Benefits Plan.' || E'\n\n' ||
    'I am currently meeting virtually with educators in ' || COALESCE(l.school_district, l.district_name, 'your district') || '.' || E'\n\n' ||
    'During our meeting, we will cover the following agenda items:' || E'\n' ||
    '● When is the soonest you are eligible to retire?' || E'\n' ||
    '● How much is your pension going to pay you?' || E'\n' ||
    '● Do you qualify for social security benefits?' || E'\n' ||
    '● Do you get both a pension and social security?' || E'\n' ||
    '● How much income will your 403b or 457 provide you in retirement?' || E'\n\n' ||
    'Here is my calendar link to select a day & time that works best for you.' || E'\n\n' ||
    'https://calendly.com/meetryancahill/strategic-planning-financial-overview' || E'\n\n' ||
    'This service is part of a state-approved financial education program for school employees. While we''re not affiliated with CalSTRS or your district, we''re here to help you make informed, confident decisions about your retirement.' || E'\n\n' ||
    'I look forward to helping you!' || E'\n\n' ||
    'Ryan Cahill' || E'\n' ||
    'Pension & Retirement Specialist' || E'\n' ||
    'Phone: 614-806-0233' || E'\n' ||
    'CA Lic. 0156729' || E'\n' ||
    'ryan@meetryancahill.com',
  personalized_at = now()
WHERE l.id IN (SELECT id FROM qualifying)

WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(active_campaign_id, '')::uuid AS configured_campaign_id
  FROM client_profiles WHERE client_id = 'ryan-cahill'
),
ryan AS (
  SELECT id FROM clients WHERE name = 'Ryan Cahill' LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO campaign_leads (campaign_id, lead_id, status, sequence_status, queue_date)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    cfg.configured_campaign_id,
    (SELECT id FROM campaigns WHERE client_id = COALESCE(l.client_id, ryan.id) AND is_active = true LIMIT 1)
  ),
  l.id, 'new', 'not_started', CURRENT_DATE
FROM leads l
CROSS JOIN cfg
CROSS JOIN ryan
WHERE l.email_valid = 'valid'
  AND l.personalized_at IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_leads cl WHERE cl.lead_id = l.id)

WITH limit_cfg AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT daily_send_limit FROM client_profiles WHERE client_id = 'ryan-cahill'), 50) AS daily_limit
),
today_sent AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n FROM sequence_tasks
  WHERE task_type = 'email_send' AND status = 'sent' AND sent_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
),
sender_pool AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT sender_pool FROM client_profiles WHERE client_id = 'ryan-cahill'),
    ARRAY['benefitcheck@benefitview.us']
  ) AS pool
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT cl.id AS campaign_lead_id, cl.campaign_id, l.id AS lead_id, l.email, l.first_name, l.full_name,
         l.email_subject, l.email_body, l.school_district,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY cl.created_at ASC) - 1 AS rn
  FROM campaign_leads cl
  JOIN leads l ON l.id = cl.lead_id
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = cl.campaign_id
  WHERE c.is_active = true
    AND cl.status = 'new'
    AND cl.sequence_status = 'not_started'
    AND l.email_valid = 'valid'
    AND l.email_subject IS NOT NULL
    AND l.email_body IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list sup WHERE lower(sup.email) = lower(l.email)
    )
)
SELECT
  candidates.campaign_lead_id, candidates.campaign_id, candidates.lead_id, candidates.email,
  candidates.first_name, candidates.full_name, candidates.email_subject, candidates.email_body,
  candidates.school_district,
  (sender_pool.pool)[(candidates.rn % array_length(sender_pool.pool, 1)) + 1] AS sender_account
FROM candidates
CROSS JOIN sender_pool
ORDER BY candidates.rn
LIMIT LEAST(
  10,
  GREATEST((SELECT daily_limit FROM limit_cfg) - (SELECT n FROM today_sent), 0)
)

WITH task AS (
  INSERT INTO sequence_tasks (campaign_lead_id, task_type, scheduled_for, status, email_step, subject_line, email_body, sent_at)
  VALUES ($1, 'email_send', now(), 'sent', 1, $2, $3, now())
  RETURNING id
),
updated_cl AS (
  UPDATE campaign_leads SET
    status = 'contacted',
    sequence_status = 'active',
    last_contacted_at = now(),
    next_action_at = now() + interval '4 days'
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_events (campaign_lead_id, event_type, recipient_email, subject, metadata)
SELECT $1, 'sent', $4, $2, jsonb_build_object('sender', $5)
FROM task

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.campaign_lead_id }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.email_subject }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.email_body }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.email }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.sender_account }}

parameters.query:
WITH task AS (
  INSERT INTO sequence_tasks (campaign_lead_id, task_type, scheduled_for, status, email_step, subject_line, email_body, error_message)
  VALUES ($1, 'email_send', now(), 'failed', 1, $2, $3, $4)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_events (campaign_lead_id, event_type, recipient_email, subject, metadata)
SELECT $1, 'failed', $5, $2, jsonb_build_object('error', $4, 'sender', $6)
FROM task

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.campaign_lead_id }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.email_subject }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.email_body }}, ={{ $json.error?.message || 'send failed' }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.email }}, ={{ $('Loop Send — 1 at a time').item.json.sender_account }}
